question: ¿Cuántos genes distintos son target de los fármacos que se prueban en ensayos detenidos (terminados o retirados) de cáncer de páncreas?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT tg.gene_symbol)
FROM aact.studies s
JOIN linking.trial_condition tc ON tc.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
JOIN mesh.descriptor d ON d.id = a.ancestor_id AND d.label = 'Pancreatic Neoplasms'
JOIN linking.trial_drug td ON td.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN linking.drug_target dt ON dt.parent_chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
JOIN linking.target_gene tg ON tg.target_chembl_id = dt.target_chembl_id
WHERE s.overall_status IN ('TERMINATED','WITHDRAWN')
